FAIL_TO_PASS: recursive-property-access: handles accessing different properties in recursive calls with good performance
recursive-calls-without-treeshake: Avoid maximum call stack error with recursive calls when treeshake is disabled
supports-es5-shim: supports es5-shim
supports-core-js: supports core-js
assignment-target-is-deoptimized: makes sure the assignment target is deoptimized
create-undefined-export-property-compact: creates an export as an exports property even if is has no initializer
conditional-definition: avoids infinite loop when testing conditional definitions
deopt-regexp-type: deoptimizes typeof for regular expressions to better support es6-sim
for-loops-as-assignments: make sure for loops are counted as variable assignments (#2199)
for-loop-parameter: includes for-loop parameters
self-deoptimization: handles situations where a member expression is deoptimized while being deoptimized
aliased-not-exported-twice: does not export aliased binding under original name (#438)
redeclare-parameter-var-function: allows to redeclare parameters as var or function
side-effect-m: detects side-effects in circular function calls
deoptimize-call-expression-reassignments: deoptimizes call expressions of conditional expressions if their return value is reassigned
do-not-optimize: do not tree-shake literal parameter cases
try-catch-inclusion: tracks assigments included via try-catch-deoptimization
track-awaited-object: tracks object mutations through await
track-async-function-return-value: tracks object mutations of async function return values
reassigned-return-expression: does not bind return expressions before assignments are bound (#3382)
